first_party_sources.scope: current published terms for licensing EPO databases
findings: The published terms describe contract formation through EPO acceptance of the licensee's order.
PATSTAT single orders deliver a copy of the database in its most recent version.
Article 5.2 distinguishes a licensee's own product containing or based on EPO data from a copy of the database or the data as such.
Article 5.4 restricts making the EPO database, a copy, or data as such public and restricts distribution of data as such absent express written EPO authorization.
Articles 6.1-6.2 impose control and security obligations for EPO database copies and data.
Article 10.2 specifies attribution for products, websites, and interfaces through which products containing sourced EPO data are accessed.
Article 17 permits amendments to the terms and describes notice and effective-date mechanics, so current web terms do not prove the exact terms applicable to the Autumn 2025 delivery.
The EPO currently describes PATSTAT Global as available through several access routes, including a subscription-based bulk data set.
This page does not establish the exact contract terms governing the specific Autumn 2025 delivery represented in the repository.
